name: Edificio Intempo
title: Intempo – Venta de apartamentos en Benidorm
paragraphs: Towering over one of the most privileged areas in the Mediterranean, next to the quiet Poniente beach in Benidorm, stands Intempo, the most imposing building on the Mediterranean coast, and the main emblem of this town’s famous skyline.
Its extraordinary location, its singular architecture and its exclusive communal areas give residents an incredible array of experiences in this unique building in Europe.
TO ENJOY SWIMMING ALL YEAR ROUND WITH MAGNIFICENT VIEWS
THE BEST GASTRONOMY IN A UNIQUE LOCATION, OUR RESTAURANTS ON THE GROUND FLOOR AND ROOFTOP
ADVANCED EQUIPMENT ON AN EXCLUSIVE FLOOR FOR SPORT AND RELAXATION.
